verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows BigQuery being exposed to other agents via the 'MCP Toolbox for Databases' MCP server (bigquery-docs-98, bigquery-probe-1) — i.e., BigQuery acting as an MCP server so external agents can call it, not BigQuery itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to gain new tools. No documentation shows BigQuery's Gemini-powered conversational analytics or any other component consuming external MCP servers.
